[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] TierPoint provides colocation, cloud, and managed IT services from a portfolio the company and its majority owner describe as roughly 40 data centers across about 18 to 20 U.S. markets. This session traced and dated the companys ownership structure, previously recorded without a clear citation chain: institutional investor Argo Infrastructure Partners began investing in TierPoint in 2020, added a further 500 million dollars in 2022, and took a majority stake by 2024. Per Argos own December 9, 2025 press release, Argo then acquired the equity interests of most of TierPoints remaining minority shareholders, consolidating its control and bringing total capital formation under Argos ownership to 3 billion dollars since 2020. Separately, per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Apollo Global Management announced in January 2025 that it would acquire Argo Infrastructure Partners itself, adding about 6 billion dollars in assets to Apollos infrastructure platform, with closing expected in the second quarter of 2025, meaning Argos majority stake in TierPoint now sits within Apollos broader infrastructure platform. This specific row, TierPoint Valley Forge, per the operators own dedicated page for this facility, fetched fresh this session, sits at 1000 Adams Avenue, Norristown, PA 19403, internally coded VFO, part of a 137 acre campus commonly known as TekPark. The United States Postal Service city for zip 19403 is Norristown, consistent with this registrys Montgomery County label, though the surrounding unincorporated area is also locally called Eagleville, which likely explains city labels of Eagleville, Audubon, or Philadelphia seen on some third party aggregator listings for the same building. Per the operators own October 23, 2025 press release, TierPoint completed a 240 million dollar asset backed securitization and used the proceeds to acquire this campus outright, describing it as the companys largest formerly leased data center.

reading.body:
TierPoint Valley Forge sits on a 137-acre campus in Norristown, Pennsylvania that the operator acquired outright in October 2025 using proceeds from a 240 million dollar securitization, marking its largest formerly leased facility. The campus is operated by TierPoint, now majority-owned by Apollo Global Management through its acquisition of majority stakeholder Argo Infrastructure Partners in early 2025. Published power capacity for this campus is not disclosed.

Pennsylvania has 14 mapped data center facilities, of which only 4 publish power capacity figures totaling 22.2 MW across the state. This campus ranks fifth among those four facilities in published megawatts, though the operator has not published its specific capacity. Without a disclosed figure, the campus cannot be placed against the state's published total or assessed for its share of Pennsylvania's data center footprint.

The absence of published capacity limits what can be said about whether this campus matters to AI infrastructure. The facility's recent acquisition and securitization suggest capital commitment and operational consolidation under a larger institutional owner, but neither the operator's portfolio scale nor the specific power available at this location provides a basis to assess its role in scaling AI compute. The certifications and service classes offered at Valley Forge are not published on the operator's spec page.
